text: The City Clerk's Office received notice on April 15, 2021, that Brittany Misurec has resigned from the Board. The resignation was made effective the day the City Clerk's Office received the notice. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are currently leading a process to recruit applicants for this vacancy along with four other Board positions, which City Council is expected to consider in July 2021.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo received the item for information.
